description: Implementation of a dynamic integer vector data structure with functions for initialization, creation, addition, search, removal, and cleanup.

methods.name: INT_VECTOR_Init
methods.description: Initializes an integer vector structure by setting its pointer to NULL and entry count to zero.

methods.name: INT_VECTOR_Create
methods.description: Creates a vector with a specified number of entries, all initialized to a given value.

methods.name: INT_VECTOR_Add
methods.description: Adds an integer to the vector, reallocating memory in chunks to optimize performance.

methods.name: INT_VECTOR_Find
methods.description: Searches for a specific integer in the vector and returns its index or INVALID if not found.

methods.name: INT_VECTOR_Remove
methods.description: Removes all occurrences of a specified integer from the vector.

methods.name: INT_VECTOR_RemoveUnusedEntries
methods.description: Removes all entries marked as INVALID, compacting the vector.

methods.name: INT_VECTOR_Destroy
methods.description: Frees the vector memory and resets the entry count.
